normalize_rules: strip volatile timestamps matching ISO-8601 patterns
replace absolute temp dirs (/tmp/... or OS equiv) with <TMP>
collapse runs of whitespace to single space
preserve target repo/path and command semantics
recurrence_rule: same fingerprint twice without changed input_digest or evidence_digest forces FORCE_RCA route

decisions.LOG_ONLY: First occurrence; ledger entry written; no RCA required.
decisions.FORCE_RCA: Same normalized fingerprint recurred with unchanged inputs; RCA routing required.
decisions.LOG_NEW_VARIANT: Same fingerprint skeleton but input_digest or evidence_digest changed; treated as a new variant, not a recurrence.

ledger_entry_schema.fingerprint: sha256 hex string of normalized fingerprint fields
